result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, matching the other per-rep and purchase-order reports. All four tests in `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` pass, including a new one for your Anna/Bob example.

- **Fix:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6516). The purchase-order subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`. Ordering and zero-count reps are unchanged.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. I added a `purchaseOrder` overload that takes a status, and a new test `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`. It reproduces the example and expects `Anna:2, Bob:1`. The existing tests didn't cover cancelled orders, so without this the fix would have been unverified.

Nothing is committed.
